findings.failure_condition: When known_complete_range describes an incomplete prefix or interior range, plan_target_source_read selects that already-known range again (for example 0..known.end) instead of the missing physical range, so repeated requests can replay old bytes and never progress coverage to the full snapshot.
findings.violated_invariant: Derive the next bounded read from the missing part of the snapshot, advance the accumulated complete range monotonically, and prove that a valid known_complete_range request reaches full-snapshot coverage without replaying the old range.

findings.failure_condition: The multi-window loop appends every decoded SourceRecord into one records Vec, and target mapping then clones and sorts that cumulative set; a large but budget-valid backfill therefore retains the full raw history in memory despite bounded I/O windows.
findings.violated_invariant: Keep raw-record residency bounded to the current window and carry only the formal adapter/reducer/checkpoint state needed across windows, while preserving deterministic chronological output and stable logical keys.

findings.failure_condition: find_previous_line_start performs a potentially long backward seek/read loop without receiving or checking cancellation/deadline control; cancellation is checked only before entering it, so an oversized line or long boundary scan can remain unresponsive during boundary I/O.
findings.violated_invariant: Thread request control through boundary discovery and check cancellation/deadline within the backward scan so planning and boundary I/O terminate promptly, with a test that changes control state during the scan rather than only before the request.

findings.failure_condition: The newly admitted P-12 test only checks non-empty tool details, turn IDs, and keys, does not prove a tool begin/end straddles windows or that logical keys remain equal across overlap/retry, and explicitly asserts that known_complete_range rereads 0..known.end, locking in the range-progression defect.
findings.violated_invariant: Use independently specified assertions for exact cross-window tool association, key equality across reread/overlap, correct missing-range progression to terminal coverage, and the required pending/gap/mutation/checkpoint fail-closed cases.

findings.failure_condition: The verification report claims a 200-byte segment limit, cross-window begin/end attribution, reproducible stable keys, and incompatible-checkpoint/gap coverage, while the recorded test uses a 1000-byte limit and its assertions do not establish those claimed behaviors or all listed negative cases.
findings.violated_invariant: Make the report and CR state only behavior directly established by the persisted tests and recorded commands, using the actual fixture and segment parameters; add the missing assertions before claiming the broader C1 evidence.
